instruction: Turn on the auto-save feature in LibreOffice Impress settings to prevent data loss

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to enable auto-save feature in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks the /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document path in registrymodifications.xcu for the AutoSave property being set to true.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves the LibreOffice config file (registrymodifications.xcu) that stores auto-save settings
Metric logic correctly navigates XML structure to /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document path and checks AutoSave property
Expected value is semantically correct - task requires enabling auto-save, expected={'enabled': true}
Boolean comparison logic is appropriate for this verification
File-based verification is valid because LibreOffice persists settings to XML file immediately when OK is clicked in settings dialog
Error handling properly covers XML parse errors and missing file cases
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add logging to report the actual AutoSave value found for debugging purposes
Minor: Static warning about missing postconfig is a false positive - LibreOffice writes settings to file immediately, no UI reopening needed
